title: identical warn log at two semantically different try_send sites
description: Both Full arms emit 'SSE client channel full; dropping stalled connection'. In a production log trace you cannot tell which branch fired: the empty-batch close-signal path (256 Nones queued without consumption — extraordinary) vs the normal event path (stalled consumer). When debugging a stalled-client report from logs alone, you need to know which branch. Add a distinguisher, e.g. warn\!('SSE client channel full; dropping stalled connection (close-signal)') at line 396 and '(state event)' at line 440.
